name: Kintsugi Card
description: A card crossed by fine cracks that fill with gold, poured from the point nearest the pointer, when you come near.

props.name: seed
props.description: Picks the crack pattern. The same seed and size always break the same way.

props.name: cracks
props.description: Number of main cracks crossing the card. Each grows one or two branches.

props.name: color
props.description: Colour of the gold. Its lighter core and the warm shadow under it are derived from it.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the card. It is rounded-2xl, bordered and padded by default.

props.name: children
props.description: The card's content, drawn above the cracks.
